seoFaq.a: The site does not charge and does not ask for a credit card. You need a free Agnes API key. It is stored only in this browser’s localStorage.

seoFaq.q: Do I need to install anything?
seoFaq.a: No. All three tabs run in the browser. Creative-video stitching uses ffmpeg.wasm, so you do not install ffmpeg yourself.

seoFaq.q: Which model does single-shot clip use, and how long does it take?
seoFaq.a: The model is agnes-video-2.5-flash (Video 2.5 Flash). A clip is 4–12 seconds. The page checks status every 30 seconds for up to 15 minutes. A few minutes is typical when the free queue is quiet; a busy queue takes longer.

seoFaq.q: Can I use reference images or a first and last frame?
seoFaq.a: Yes. You can attach up to 5 reference images, and you can also pass reference audio URLs. First/last frame requires a first frame; the last frame is optional. That mode’s output ratio is fixed to square by the upstream service.

seoFaq.q: How is multi-shot story different from single-shot clip?
seoFaq.a: Single-shot clip makes one clip. Multi-shot story splits one idea into 2–5 scenes, generates each scene, then stitches them in the browser. The Web Studio link in the navigation opens multi-shot story directly.

seoFaq.q: What if I see 503 or “video queue is full”?
seoFaq.a: The free queue is full. No task was created and no quota was spent. The page retries automatically. If it stays full, try again at a quieter time. The Jimeng and queue FAQ explains the rest.

seoFaq.q: Why does a 9:16 video look sideways?
seoFaq.a: Video 2.5 Flash sometimes delivers 9:16 clips rotated by 90 degrees. The framing is still vertical. Rotate the file after download. This is a known upstream issue.
